source: Team 6 Action API (feature/harsha: action_server.py, schemas/action_api/OperationList.schema.json). Not an organiser contract: none was supplied.

operations.name: restart_service
operations.description: Restart one allowlisted application or worker container (docker restart).
operations.use_when: the diagnosed service's own process is crashed, crash-looping, hung or starved of CPU/memory
operations.risk: In-flight requests to the service fail while it restarts (typically 5-20s). Does not fix bad code, configuration, dependencies or network faults.
operations.expected_effect: The container restarts and resumes reporting; faults caused by a crashed, stopped or hung process clear.
operations.verification_plan: Compare the service's error rate, p95 latency, CPU/memory and restarts with the pre-incident baseline for 3-5 min after the restart; if they do not return to baseline, escalate.
